Got caught in 4K but at least the dessert was worth the drama 😂

Paris’ viral chocolate mousse has officially landed at Global Village, and having tried the OG in Paris, OBVIOUSLY I had to investigate!! The mousse was pretty yum, super rich and you could tell they used good quality chocolate. The hot and cold chocolate drinks were kinda nice, not as rich, which helped balance out the dessert. Basically, a very chocolatey situation I was happy to be in 😂

📍 Thailand XOCO BAR - Thailand Pavilion, Global Village
💸 35 AED
